businesses.business: healthcare software and revenue cycle services

offering_description.value: CareCloud handles medical billing and collections and sells software for managing patient records and practice operations. It serves physician practices, medical groups, and health systems through cloud applications and outsourced service teams.

primary_products.value: electronic health records software; practice management software; medical billing software; patient engagement and telehealth software; practice analytics software

primary_services.value: revenue cycle management and medical coding; practice administration; provider credentialing; healthcare staffing; remote patient monitoring and chronic care management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent physician practices, specialty medical groups, hospitals, health systems, and medical billing companies

end_markets.value: outpatient healthcare; hospital care; medical billing services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Medical billing and collections priced as a share of practice collections; subscription: Recurring access to cloud software for clinical and administrative work; service fees: Provider credentialing, staffing, and other outsourced practice operations
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes clinical and claims data to manage billing and collections for healthcare providers; software / platform: Develops cloud applications that healthcare providers use to manage records, scheduling, and payments

specialization.value: related lines: Healthcare billing, clinical and practice software, patient engagement, and outsourced practice operations
